missions.name: Dead Stock Risk Assessment
missions.query: Which products have a stock count of zero in all inventory locations, indicating potential dead stock?

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies Across Suppliers
missions.query: Which product styles have inconsistent sizes across different suppliers?

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Delays
missions.query: Which suppliers consistently fail to meet their lead time commitments, resulting in stockouts?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches by Channel
missions.query: Which sales channels have consistently breached reorder points for specific products, indicating stockouts?

missions.name: Inventory Imbalances Across Locations
missions.query: Which products have stock count imbalances across different inventory locations?

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Delivery Performance
missions.query: Which suppliers have consistently failed to deliver products on time, impacting stock levels?

missions.name: Sales Event Product Bundling
missions.query: Which products are frequently bundled together in sales events, indicating potential demand patterns?

missions.name: Product Seasonality and Demand Patterns
missions.query: Which products have consistently varying demand patterns throughout the year, indicating seasonality?

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Distribution
missions.query: Which suppliers have a non-uniform lead time distribution across all products, indicating potential stockout risks?

missions.name: Stock Imbalance by Location and Supplier
missions.query: Which products have stock count imbalances across different inventory locations, and which suppliers are responsible for these imbalances?

missions.name: Product Demand Seasonality
missions.query: Which products have consistently varying demand patterns throughout the year, indicating seasonality, and which sales channels are driving these trends?

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Delivery Performance
missions.query: Which suppliers have consistently delivered products on time, and which suppliers have consistently failed to meet their on-time commitments?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches by Channel and Product
missions.query: Which sales channels have consistently breached reorder points for specific products, indicating stockouts, and which products are most affected?

missions.name: Product Supplier Concentration Risk
missions.query: Which products have a high concentration of suppliers, and which suppliers are responsible for these concentrations, indicating potential supply chain risks?

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Variance by Product
missions.query: Which suppliers have a high variance in lead time across different products, indicating potential stockout risks, and which products are most affected?

missions.name: Inventory Location Optimization
missions.query: Which inventory locations have the highest stock turnover rates, indicating potential optimization opportunities, and which products are driving these trends?

missions.name: Supplier Country Risk
missions.query: Which suppliers are located in countries with high risk profiles, and which products are most affected by these risks?

missions.name: Product Bundle Analysis
missions.query: Which products are frequently bundled together in sales events, indicating potential demand patterns, and which bundles are most popular?

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Variance
missions.query: Which suppliers have a lead time variance greater than 20% compared to the average lead time across all suppliers?

missions.name: Product Size Distribution Across Suppliers
missions.query: For each product style, calculate the distribution of sizes across different suppliers, and identify styles with an uneven distribution of sizes (e.g., one supplier dominates the market for a particular size)

missions.name: Reorder Point Optimization
missions.query: Analyze the sales history and inventory levels for each product to identify optimal reorder points that minimize stockouts and overstocking

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Delivery Rate Trend
missions.query: Plot the on-time delivery rate trend for each supplier over the past year to identify any significant changes or anomalies

missions.name: Product Seasonality Analysis
missions.query: Analyze the sales history for each product to identify any seasonality patterns, and calculate the average sales volume for each product during peak and off-peak seasons

missions.name: Inventory Turnover Ratio
missions.query: Calculate the inventory turnover ratio for each product and supplier to identify slow-moving or dead stock, and analyze the ratio over time to identify any trends or anomalies

missions.name: Supplier Country-Based Lead Time Analysis
missions.query: Analyze the lead time for each supplier by country to identify any regional differences or trends, and calculate the average lead time for each country

missions.name: Product Channel-Specific Demand Analysis
missions.query: Analyze the sales history for each product by sales channel to identify any channel-specific demand patterns or anomalies, and calculate the average sales volume for each product by channel

missions.name: Supplier Rating Based on On-Time Delivery and Lead Time
missions.query: Assign a rating to each supplier based on their on-time delivery rate and lead time, and calculate the average rating for each supplier over time

missions.name: Inventory Location-Based Stock Imbalance Analysis
missions.query: Analyze the stock levels for each product across different inventory locations to identify any imbalances or anomalies, and calculate the average stock imbalance for each product over time
